# The repos the canary builds, one per line: Status' Nim libraries (the status-im
# repos on Status' shared CI workflow) and two of the projects built on them, then
# packages from the wider Nim community. Each one is built the same way, as the
# build job in .github/workflows/canary.yml shows; `install-only` skips
# `nimble test`. The order doesn't matter: the slowest repos start first.
#
# To look for status-im repos on the shared workflow that aren't listed yet:
#   gh search code "nimbus-common-workflow/.github/workflows/common.yml" --owner status-im

# The community: packages whose `nimble test` passes on a plain runner (most are on
# Nim's own package CI, testament/important_packages.nim), and, install-only,
# projects whose dependencies exercise nimble: lock files, `#sha`, URL and forked
# requirements, features, and dependencies with binaries, hooks or submodules.
treeform/pixie
SciNim/Datamancer
karaxnim/karax
PMunch/nimlsp
nim-lang/langserver
nim-lang/c2nim
nitely/nim-regex

niv/neverwinter.nim
squattingmonk/nasher
Vindaar/ggplotnim install-only         # its tests need cairo
HugoGranstrom/nimiSlides install-only  # no tests
fox0430/moe install-only               # its tests need X11
HapticX/happyx install-only            # its tests run servers
zedeus/nitter install-only             # its tests need Redis and libpcre
nim-lang/nimforum install-only         # its tests need a browser
nim-lang/choosenim install-only        # its tests download Nim
arnetheduck/nph install-only           # no tests
dom96/jester install-only              # its tests need libpcre
planety/prologue install-only          # `nimble test` finds no tests
treeform/boxy install-only             # its tests need OpenGL
crashappsec/chalk install-only         # its tests need Docker
inv2004/ttop install-only              # no tests
krisppurg/dimscord install-only        # its tests aren't run upstream either
